newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market afternoon report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market afternoon report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were steady to slightly firmer at the close after shrugging off U.S. April jobs data.
The U.S. April jobless rate fell by 0.3 percentage points to 4.9 percent -- a 23-year low -- from 5.2 percent in March.
But Swiss traders said activity was exceptionally thin due to the fact that many operators were absent, having extended Thursday's Labour Day holiday into a long weekend.
Separately, Swiss National Bank board member Bruno Gehrig warned against excessive monetary policy loosening to solve structural problems within the economy.
